paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani thum ni a David leh amite Ziklag atun un, Amalekte'n simlam leh Ziklag khua ana sim khin uh. Ziklag khua ana sual ua, mei in ana hal uhi.
heading: Amalekte Toh Kidouna

paite: Numeite leh khua a om peuhmah aneu-alian sal in aman ua, kuamah that lou a pi in apaipih khinta uhi.
David leh amite khua ava tun un, ngai in, ana kangsiang khinta hi. Azite, atapate leh atanute uh sal in ana man khinta uhi.
David leh akiang a omte'n aw suah in kah leng kap zou nawn lou khop in akap uhi.
David zite nih: Jezreel mi Ahinoam leh Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail leng sal a pi in a-om uhi.
Michih atapate uh leh atánute uh ziak a lungkham in amah suang a den ding thu agen ziak un, David alungzing mahmah hi. Himahleh David bel. TOUPA a Pathian ah akihihhat hi.
David in Ahimelek tapa siampu Abiathar kiang ah, "Siampu puanak hon va laksak dih ve," achi hi. Abiathar in David siampu puanak ava laksak hi.
David in, "Hiaite delh leng ka pha lai diam?" chi in TOUPA adong hi. Ama'n adawng a, "Delh in, na pha ngeingei ding, na la nawn vek ding," achi hi.
Huchi in David, amah leh akiang a mi zaguk toh akuankhia a, Besor lui ava tung ua, ami nutsiatte uh huai ah a-om uhi.
David in adelh zel a, amah leh mi zalite toh, mi zanihte'n abah tak ziak un Besor lui akan zou kei uhi,
Gamlak ah Aigupta mi amu ua, David kiang ah api ua, tanghou apia ua, ama'n ane a, tui adawnsak uhi.
Theipi beu them khat leh grep gah phoukeu bawm nih apia uhi. Hiaite anekleh ahong halh nawn a; ni thum leh zan thum an ne lou leh tui dawn lou lah ahita ngal a.
David in akiang ah, "Kua na hia? Koi a kipan a hong na hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Aigupta gam tangval, Amalek mi sikha ka hi. Ni thum ahita a, ka chi anat ziak in ka pu in hon nusia maimah hi.
Kereth sim gam leh Judah sim gamte ka sim ua, Kaleb sim gam leng ka sim ua, huchi in Ziklag khua leng ka hal uh," achi hi.

David in akiang ah, "Huaite omna ah na hon pisuk thei diam?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Hon that lou ding leh ka pu khut a hon pe nawn lou ding in Pathian min lou in ka kiang ah kichiam inla, huchi in huaite omna ah ka hon pisuk ding," achi hi.
Apisukleh, ngai in, Philistia gam leh Judah gam a gallak tampi alak ziak un ankuang alui ua, ane un adawn ua mun teng ah ana om dalh phengphung uhi.
Huchi in David in nitum a pan zingsang nitaklam tan in amau asual hi. Tangval zali sangawngsau tung a tuang a taikekte kia lou ngal kuamah dam a suakta himhim a-om kei uh.
David in Amalek mite puakmang tengteng ala nawn vek a, David in azi nihte leng ahunkheta hi.
Huchi in aneu-alian in, atapate uh, atanute uh, agallak uh leh athil lak himhim bangmah tan anei kei ua, David in alaksak nawn vek hi.
David in belamhon leh ganhon tengteng ala a, gan dangte ma ah ahawl ua, "Hiaite David gallak ahi," achi uhi.

Mi zanih abah ziak ua David zuizou nawn lou a Besor lui a a-omsakte uh kiang ah David ava tung hi. Amau David dawn ding leh akiang a omte dawn ding in apawtkhia uh. Mite kiang atun in David in amaute chibai abuk hi.

David kiang a hohte lak a migiloute leh Belial mi teng in adawng ua, "I kiang ua ahong tel louh ziak un gallak thil i va lak nawn himhimte amau i pe kei ding uh. Api ua apaitheihna ding un azite chiat uh leh atate chiat uh ahihleh api uh i phal ding uh, achi uhi.
David in, "Unaute aw, TOUPA eite hon kembitpa'n ahon piakleh eite dou dia hong kuante i khut ua hon pepa thilte huchi in hih kei un.
Kua'n ahia hiai thu a na thu uh zui ding? Kidouna a hohte tan bangmah van veng a na omte'n leng atan sam ding uh ahi; kibang vek a tan ding ahi," achi hi.
Huai ni a pan tuni tan in Israelte a dia thupiak leh dan thuseh ding in abawlta hi.
David, Ziklag khua atun in, gallak khenkhat, hiai, TOUPA melmate lak a gallak, nang a dia thilpiak, chi in Judah upate, alawmte ngei kiang ah, gallak khenkhat akhak hi.
Bethel a omte kiang ah, Ramoth sim a omte kiang ah, Jattir a omte kiang ah,
Aroer a omte kiang ah, Siphmoth a omte kiang ah, Eshtemoa a omte kiang ah;
Rakal a omte kiang ah, Jerahmeel a omte kiang ah, Kente a omte kiang ah;
Hormah a omte kiang ah, Bor-ashan a omte kiang ah, Athak a omte kiang ah;
Hebron a omte kiang ah, David leh amite tatna mun tengteng kiang ah.
